newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT HARLEQUINS 33-29 IN CHALLENGE MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT HARLEQUINS 33-29 IN CHALLENGE MATCH.

text.p: Auckland Blues beat English first division club Harlequins 33-29 (halftime 12-22) in a rugby union challenge match at the Stoop Memorial Ground on Tuesday.
Auckland - Tries: Joeli Vidiri, Junior Tonu'u, Brian Lima, Mark Carter, Richard Fromont. Conversion: Adrian Cashmore. Penalties: Cashmore (2).
Harlequins - Tries: Dominic Chapman, Peter Mensah, Gareth Llewellyn, Nick Walshe. Conversions: Thierry Lacroix (2), Mike Corcoran. Penalty: Lacroix.
